method: Local exported web, fresh Chrome contexts, public discovery response replay, live image requests, 15-second autoplay; mobile emulation: 4x CPU, 150ms RTT, 1.6Mbps down/750Kbps up. Entry metrics describe community navigation, homeReadyMs describes SPA home transition. Interaction duration is a lab sample, not field INP. Long-task excess covers the whole observed session and is not Lighthouse TBT. Static localhost serves uncompressed assets, not production CDN compression. Native Android, production cache and concurrency capacity are not measured.
